items.title: Lloyd Pierce is very upset with the officials. Just looking at hand motions, it seems like they're suggesting he called for a challenge on a play that he did not actually challenge, but that's a far-away read on the situation,. Long exchange. Ends with Oscar Tshiebwe at the line.
